Your current card is around 7.5/10.
With the changes above, it would be around 9.8/10—more like the testimonial sections used by modern SaaS sites such as Linear, Vercel, or Stripe.
I recommend not using an expanding "View Less" inside the card. A "Read More" button that opens a centered modal is cleaner, keeps all cards the same height, and provides a better user experience.
